blurb: Our family campground is located on the beautiful Nanticoke River in the Lower Shore of Maryland. Our setting provides guests with opportunities to enjoy fishing, crabbing, swimming, hiking, or simply a lazy day to kick back and relax. We offer separate fishing and swimming beaches, along with two boat ramps and a pier.
